title: Galois-Ring Diffusion for Integer-Ring Ciphers
summary: The paper analyzes ciphers with matrix-multiplication diffusion, while construction and analysis with a Galois-ring diffusion function remain open.

formal_statement.body: Study how to construct and analyze a cipher over $\mathbb{Z}_{p^n}^{\,t}$ in which the matrix multiplication $M$ is replaced by a function over $\operatorname{GR}(p^n,t)$ that provides diffusion.

scope.domain: Design and analysis of symmetric ciphers over integer-ring modules using diffusion functions over Galois rings.
parameters: p, n, and t: parameters defining the cipher domain and the Galois ring
M: the matrix-multiplication component to be replaced
a function over GR(p^n,t): the replacement component that provides diffusion
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct and analyze a cipher over the stated domain after replacing M with a diffusion-providing function over GR(p^n,t).

citations.label: The ABC of Symmetric Primitives over Integer Rings: Milk Before Meat

progress.summary: A remark presents replacing matrix multiplication with a function over a Galois ring that provides diffusion as an alternative construction strategy and leaves studying this case open for future work.
citation_labels: Tim Beyne et al., The ABC of Symmetric Primitives over Integer Rings: Milk Before Meat
